stories.headline: Meta tests humans behind Muse AI phone calls
stories.summary: Meta used contractors to handle some calls placed through Muse, then rolled back the test after disclosure and privacy concerns. Meta says any public launch would include safeguards and proper disclosure.

stories.headline: Anthropic expands medical AI to poorer countries
stories.summary: Anthropic and OpenEvidence will offer free AI clinical-decision support in dozens of lower-income countries. Critics caution that systems trained in richer countries may not reflect local practice.

stories.headline: Trump threatens Iran while holding out for a deal
stories.summary: Trump warned at the UN that he could escalate the Iran war if no deal is reached, while predicting an agreement after the US midterms. He later said envoys met mediators, not Iranian officials directly.

stories.headline: US halts Obamacare coverage for 760,000
stories.summary: CMS canceled about 315,000 plans covering more than 760,000 people over alleged improper enrollment. A broker trade group says a blanket registration freeze may also hurt legitimate agents and access.

stories.headline: China military purges raise readiness questions
stories.summary: Diplomats and analysts say command purges may dent China’s war-fighting readiness while strengthening Xi Jinping’s control. China’s defense ministry did not immediately comment.
